thread:
Alex G: quick heads-up — flight to SFO delayed, I need someone to cover primary from 21:00-02:00 UTC tonight. I can be available until 21:00 and then reachable by DM for escalation. sorry for the short notice.
Mira K: I can pick up 21:00-23:30 UTC (can be primary from my laptop). I have a support call at 23:40 so would need to handover by 23:30.
Jon P: I can shadow 21:00-00:30 and take over at 23:30 if Mira has to leave early. :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT: 5xx spike detected on /v1/generate — Pager triggered to oncall-primary at 21:05 UTC. Spike started 21:03 UTC, error-rate 2.4% over baseline.
Sara L: I'm secondary for tonight; grabbing context now. Which runbook are we following? Any customer-facing impact yet?
Alex G: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-spike — main actions: scale inference pool, check recent routing config, toggle canary if needed. No confirmed customer-facing incidents yet, just elevated 5xx rate and some latency.
Mira K: ok, I'm on primary console. I'll apply a temporary scale up of dedicated workers and watch token queue. Paging history shows 2x increase in errors over last 3m.
Jon P: scaling command that works for the infra team is:
```
# scale inference pool (cluster: inference-prod)
kubectl -n inference-prod scale deploy/redwood-inference --replicas=18
```
I'll stand by to run that if you want me to.
Sara L: I'll monitor alerts and start a short timeline in the incident sheet. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ops/5xx-overview. If customers start hitting errors >2% sustained, we should open a Customer Impact note.
Alex G: plan for swap: Mira takes primary 21:00-23:30, Jon hot-swap to primary 23:30-02:00, Sara remains secondary the whole window. I'll leave my laptop open until 21:00 for any questions and will DM creds for any emergency escalations.
Deploy Bot: deploybot: Canary deploy routing-service v1.2.4 scheduled at 21:15 UTC. Automatic pause threshold: 5xx > 1% for 2 intervals.
Mira K: noted — if the spike persists after scale, pause the canary and revert routing. I'll apply scale now and watch 5m windows.
Jon P: I will take full handover at 23:30. Mira — can you drop a 1-line handoff at 23:25 with actions still in flight and pager link? That'll make the takeover clean.
Alex G: also: please add a short note in the oncall-schedule doc so rotations reflect this temporary swap: https://docs.internal/oncall/schedule. Adding myself as escalation contact in case things blow up.
Sara L: Added timeline + mitigation steps to incident sheet: https://sheets.internal/ops/incidents/4516789012 — noted no confirmed customer-facing impact yet. I put a stakeholder watch channel to #support-escalations.
Mira K: scale applied — replicas bumped to 18, CPU utilization per pod down, 5xx rate trending down to 0.9% after 4m. Will keep monitoring for another 15m.
Jon P: good to know. I'll be ready for takeover. Leaving a pinned checklist in the thread: 1) confirm autoscale stable 2) pause canary if >1% sustained 3) keep timeline updated 4) handoff msg at :25.
Alex G: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick sync. Mira/Jon/Sara — if anything shifts DM me and post a short line here. Safe travels to me, see you tomorrow morning. :airplane:
Mira K: thanks — will post the 23:25 handoff and mark coverage in the schedule. :white_check_mark:
Jon P: see you. I'll be primary at 23:30 UTC.
Sara L: standing by on secondary and will take customer comms if needed.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error-rate down to 0.8% after scale. No new pages in last 3m.
Mira K: leaving the thread open for handoff notes.
Jon P: copying the final handoff note below at 23:25 UTC — 
"Mira K: handoff @23:25 — scale stable, 5xx at 0.7%, canary paused manually at 21:20 for routing v1.2.4, no customer impact. Jon take over at 23:30."
Alex G: acknowledged. thanks all.
